baselineOverride.restoreProtocol: Saved raw bytes and SHA256 for both original factories and the facade, restored each in finally, verified raw-byte hashes, then reran 120 related tests.

independentReview.scope: Actual recipe UPDATE/history INSERT/pointer UPDATE root and target guards, shared pre/post/no-op/error checks, NonRetryableError conversion inside save step, original read/batch/promotion/selector semantics and unbound behavior.
independentReview.notes: Reviewer ran no tests or Git operations. Main executor owns all results.

rawArtifactPolicy: Raw temporary reports/logs are hashed, summarized here and removed after audit. Failure names, paths, reproducible command equivalents and per-file results are retained.
remainingActions: createCastRecords shared characters/looks/voices, location links and orphan cleanup, generated elements and their nested histories/pointers/claims/events remain outside this batch.
This fences automatic-style persistence, not already-started LLM spending or provider termination. Takeover can still occur after a successful check and before generation.style:ready.

The authorized style UPDATE remains separate from the snapshot batch. It can remain after later ownership loss; a live root with a concurrent user style switch retains the existing historical-row behavior.
Whole-root cancellation, other descendants and complete content/asset/realtime/phase/preview/callback ownership remain open.
Cached checkpoints, ownerless payloads, independent Update all, standalone AnalyzeScript CLI and email delivery remain open.
Deployed Workerd/D1 restart/replay, multi-instance concurrency, browser convergence, provider termination and wallet settlement acceptance remain unverified.
